all_part_contact_graph.method: Full semantic-part graph using actual vertex/triangle boundaries, enclosed points, edge/triangle and coplanar-edge intersections. AABB only rejects separated pairs; it never establishes contact.
all_part_contact_graph.limits: Geometric connectivity, not structural design, attachment strength, irrigation, load, or simulation behavior. Open folded foliage is not treated as a closed support hull.

limits: Exact triangle/box intersection and convex feasibility screen stated inset boxes; finite rays supplement them.
The complete linear bin sweep begins at t=0 and includes every actual semantic part including handles/wheels. No forces, wheel rolling behavior, player controls or host fit is certified.
Every semantic part is screened for actual geometric contact to floor support. This does not certify structural strength.
